sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/palm-bay.json: read. It had 45 maps results and 35 web results. None was a partition installer: they were remodelers, plumbers, tile and flooring shops, stores and a portable-toilet supplier. The web results were Google redirect links without domains.
Existing area files orlando.json, miami.json and tampa.json: read for Florida regional firms. I reopened the Orlando-area firms' sites to check scope and service areas.
Bobrick find-a-rep: the page loaded but rep results need the JS dropdown, so no reps were read.
Metpar find-a-rep and General Partitions find-a-representative: both returned 404.
ASI, Scranton, Hadrian and Bradley locators: not retried this run (other area runs got 404 or empty pages). Ampco/Ammco: not tried.
The Blue Book (search.html?region=4&class=3070 and iProView/802033): 403, blocked.

Procore Network: worked, but its city category pages (Melbourne, Port St. Lucie and Vero Beach toilet-bath-and-laundry-accessories; Palm Bay interior-specialties) list statewide or national firms, not local ones. BLS Building (Fort Lauderdale, 'Partitions' trade, unclear) and Smith General Trades (Gainesville, accessories only) were not included.

WebSearch: used 8 of 8. Useful results: 'Melbourne FL commercial carpentry specialties ... toilet partitions lockers Division 10' (found Mako Millwork) and the Treasure Coast and Port St. Lucie searches (confirmed there are almost no local specialists). Searches for Brevard, Palm Bay and Space Coast returned mostly plumbers.

Excluded as more than 120 miles away or national: Restroom Stalls and All (Gainesville GA; own crews install in FL), Specialty Installations & Sales (Port Richey FL; installs statewide), Watkins Accessories (Brooksville FL), Bell Architectural Specialties (Riverview FL), CS Installers (Fort Lauderdale office; site says it serves the Northeast), RTI Supply, Tri-County Partitions and Schedule 10 (South Florida), Holman (Jacksonville), and online sellers One Point Partitions, toiletpartitions.com, Partition Pros and US Partitions.
Yelp and BBB: none surfaced in the searches, so none were read.
